From8s: legal stationary support (saturates0.2BW) and good rest. From6–13s: pelvis collision-vertex distance to inset finite seat patch. Coefficients frozen in source; geometry is a shaping proxy, not a physical acceptance certificate.
revised_reward.proof: Full scaled clean return >=0.77625; any nonclean return <=0.14875. Physical classification never relaxed.
revised_reward.source_of_geometry: Saved static robot collision meshes and actual body poses; reward labels only, no actor/critic truth inputs.

validation.identity: New zero-residual source must match old calibrate two-episode fresh/indexed sequence exactly, including all trace, startup, commands and sensor arrays.
validation.checkpoints: Every update saves checkpoint and batch; actual actor/critic change and Adam counters checked after first update of each chunk. Independent CPU replay anchored to each preceding GPU checkpoint plus independent reward and geometry checks after every chunk.
validation.evaluations: Every milestone, both arms/seeds: all3x24 development cases, full20s1000ticks, deterministic mean policy. Report per-case repaired failures, lost protected cases, stable/slip/illegal/physical, effort and hold duration. No adaptive tuning or selection of a lucky seed.

acceptance: A full repair requires8/8 original failures clean and64/64 baseline clean cases retained under unchanged physical criteria. Report each arm/seed/milestone independently. No automatic promotion. Fresh24 holdout CLOSED. Sitting experiment only; no leaning training or deployment.

stops: Stop on source/input hash mismatch, reset identity, nonfinite, action-bound, independent reward/replay failure, worker conflict or resource cap. No blind retries. Exploration failures are outcomes, not grounds for stopping the learning comparison.
automation: Deleted by user. This is one finite explicitly requested experiment queue, not a recurring task.
